import json,sys,http.client,subprocess,pathlib
want="6b36acff46e1687f9e94fe5a2aab6ee1587b8fd8"
def assert_check(label,condition):
 print(label+"="+("PASS" if condition else "FAIL"),flush=True)
 if not condition:raise RuntimeError(label)
def get(path,owner=""):
 conn=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=8)
 try:
  conn.request("GET",path,headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+owner} if owner else {})
  r=conn.getresponse()
  return r.status,r.read(200000)
 finally:conn.close()
try:
 actual=subprocess.run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=8).stdout.strip()
 assert_check("CHECKOUT_SHA",actual==want)
 status,body=get("/healthz")
 assert_check("LIVE_APP_SHA",status==200 and json.loads(body).get("commit")==want)
 token=(pathlib.Path.home()/".config"/"tgtumbler"/"tumblr-operation-app"/"tumblr-app-access-token").read_text().strip()
 status,_=get("/");assert_check("OWNER_LOGIN_GUARD",status==401)
 status,body=get("/",token);assert_check("OWNER_CHAT_SCREEN",status==200 and b'id="chat-form"' in body)
 status,_=get("/oauth/status");assert_check("OWNER_OAUTH_GUARD",status==401)
 status,body=get("/oauth/status",token);assert_check("OWNER_OAUTH_RESPONSE",status==200 and isinstance(json.loads(body),dict))
 status,body=get("/library",token);assert_check("OWNER_LIBRARY_RESPONSE",status==200 and isinstance(json.loads(body),dict))
 tests=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B","-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-p","test_release_script.py","-q"],capture_output=True,timeout=35)
 assert_check("RELEASE_AI_GUARD_OFFLINE_TESTS",tests.returncode==0)
 print("EXTERNAL_PROVIDER_CALLS=ZERO")
 print("ACCEPTANCE=PASS")
except Exception as e:
 print("ACCEPTANCE=FAIL:"+type(e).__name__)
 sys.exit(42)
